name: Pipette the Lab-White Cat
blurb: Pipette, a spotless all-white shorthair with pale blue eyes and pink paws, keeps the greenhouse tidy and naps on the potting bench.

name: Capsule the Two-Tone Cat
blurb: Capsule, a sleek bicolor cat, crisp white up front and warm butterscotch behind, curls into a neat oval on the sunny stepping stones.

name: Sage the Apothecary Cat
blurb: Sage, a smoky sage-grey mackerel tabby with olive eyes, dozes among old glass jars and pots of thyme in the garden's herb bed.
